text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The time for the summer training camp is here! Staying at a seaside facility,
our days of intensive training begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Kitakyushu Kinen fast approaching,
I should make sure we prepare thoroughly for it.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Then... I'll go leave my bags in my room.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Alright. Done packing and changing—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Believe-chan...!
Um, we're roommates during the summer camp, right?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's do our best, Dantsu-san.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
...Yeah, um, so... about that.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Um. Dants-san, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um, excuse me, um!
Believe-chan—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
M-Me too! Would you mind if I
trained with you during the summer training camp...!?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
So you're thinking about switching to mile races?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
So you want to reference my daily routine
to build a body suited for shorter distances...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You know, ever since entering the Classic Class,
I've run the Triple Crown route... the Satsuki Sho and Tokyo Yushun, but—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: To be honest... I haven't been able to run the way I wanted to.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've always been hidden
in the shadows of Tachyon-chan and Pokke-chan—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I plan to enter the 'Kikuka Sho' this fall.
Because I really want to challenge for...
the title of the 'strongest' Umamusume after all.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Still, as for what comes after... I'm a bit worried.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Since the first graded race I ever won was a mile race,
I thought maybe slightly shorter distances suited me better...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Understood. Go right ahead.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right, I'm sorry?!
It's frustrating to hear me being so wishy-washy, especially with an important race coming up soon—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? O-Oh?
...Are you sure it's okay?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I need to talk to my Trainer first, but I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —What I have to do doesn't change.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's the situation.
What do you think about Dantsu-san participating?”
choice_data_list: You're right, I don't mind either.
Yeah, that's fine with me too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I said this, I smiled at Dantsu Flame,
who had been fretting like a small animal the entire
time Believe gave her matter-of-fact explanation.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...!?
Are you sure...!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll be in your care for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed so kind-hearted, worrying endlessly
about whether she was being a nuisance—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since I wanted to incorporate some practical training ahead of the race, I'm honestly grateful to always have a training partner available.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Well then.
...Trainer-san.
I'm ready for the training menu instructions.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
M-Me too...!
Um, I'll be in your care!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
First is the "Box Jump," right?
You jump onto and off of a slightly high platform,
repeating it rapidly in a short amount of time...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When the instructor was watching over me,
this was part of the regimen too!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"There are more reps than last time, so I'll have to move
even faster, but... it's training to boost agility, right?
I'll do my best!"
choice_data_list: Alright, here we go! Ready... start!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Next up is hill sprints...
all the way to the top of that hill, right?
choice_data_list: The distance is short, but the slope is steep.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"We do that while losing as little speed as possible……
right? Understood, let's do this!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, could you please
time the laps from the top of the hill?
choice_data_list: Got it. Watch your step so you don't trip!
Got it. Watch your step so you don't trip, okay!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...! N-Next up is...
the "Shoreline Dash"... right?
Dashing from the shallows toward the beach...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I-I see. Starting from high-resistance water helps build an even more powerful starting dash... doesn't it! *phew*...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —I look forward to working with you!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, phew*...!
N-Next is—!"
choice_data_list: ...Why don't you take a short break, Dants?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh! B-But—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I cautioned her that it's better not to rush.
—In truth, today's training menu must have been
quite grueling for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, she should have been training
with middle- and long-distance races in mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Stamina training is an absolute must, especially if we have long-distance races in mind. Therefore, up until now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What you'd call 'low intensity, high reps'—
in other words, plenty of long interval runs
and uphill jogging."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, as a sprinter, Believe
should focus on improving instantaneous speed and power—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The regimen is basically 'high intensity, low reps.' It revolves around applying heavy loads all at once, just like we did today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In short, she has suddenly begun tackling a training menu with almost polar opposite characteristics.
choice_data_list: It's only natural for your body to not keep up at first

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I reasoned with Dantsu Flame that pushing herself here and getting injured would ruin everything.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...That's true, thank you so much!
I'll be watching from over there.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
――Now then.
Let's move on to tire-pulling sprints, please.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (......Ah. Look at the time already.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
Um, were you just about to go to sleep...?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Dants-san... well, yes.
However...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Go ahead. What is it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...!
Um, there's just a tiny thing I'd like you to look at—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I reworked my independent training menu based on what we did today.
What do you think...?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. I don't think there's any problem.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I see...!
Thank you, Believe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, sorry about today.
I couldn't keep up till the end...
It felt like I just ended up getting in the way."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Bother...?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not.
I finished my entire routine on schedule.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh... R-Really? I seeâ

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Still, you're right. Even with me flitting around you the whole time, you never lost your focus, did you, Believe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...So amazing.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Believe-chan is truly amazing.
She's always so unwavering, or should I say...
she has such an incredibly strong core.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I've always thought you were so cool.
So straightforward, without a trace of doubt...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Because I'm always wavering back and forth—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah... oops, no good!
I kept you up late. Sorry about that.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Good night, Believe-chan!
See you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Good night.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you again tomorrow.
